The full primorial replication is reproved inductively, including the terminal jump from p_{n+1} to p_{n+2}. From it the exact s_j deletion and single boundary-label replacement give the c_n(q) recurrence. Periodic block approximants differ on at most s_j(q)+2 residues per P_j and the absolutely convergent discrepancy series yields natural densities and the strict 4/P_N error. Positivity follows from c_j(p_j)=p_j-1 and separate 3,5 cases; total mass follows from r≡1 modulo P_N for omitted primes beyond p_N. Extracted verifier passed 2,500 independent coprime transitions, 64 labelled recurrence comparisons and exact level-12 counts; finite computation is explicitly supplementary.

value.rationale: The complete countably infinite gap law, positivity of every allowable prime-minus-one jump, conservation of total record mass, and fast exact arithmetic bounds answer a natural distribution question arising in a 2023 study of composite and twin records. Unlike a mere new finite pattern or substitution, it determines all fixed-gap asymptotic frequencies of an established arithmetic dynamical sequence and supplies a general labelled counting mechanism. The twin-record-start density is determined to approximately 12 decimal places with rigorous error; no claim about ordinary twin primes is made.
